copy_semantics_audit.copy_creation_condition: For ordinary cross-backend inputs with an unsupported source buffer, copies are indexed by source tensor, target backend and copy slot within the scheduler graph; consumers share the copy in that slot. copy_semantics_audit.copy_execution: CPU-to-CUDA cannot succeed through the CUDA-specific async-copy callback because it requires CUDA backends and buffers at both ends. copy_semantics_audit.reuse_synchronization: Per-backend copy slots are protected by prior split event waits; split completion records an event, and missing event support falls back to backend synchronization.
